educational_overlay.purpose: Drafts structured AI Impact Assessments evaluating societal, fundamental rights, and security implications of LLM systems.
educational_overlay.when_to_use: When launching customer-facing AI agents, automated chatbots, or predictive scoring models.
educational_overlay.when_not_to_use: For standard spell-checkers or static business intelligence dashboards.

variables.label: Input Data Category
variables.default: Customer support transcripts and order IDs

educational_overlay.prompt_template:
Generate an AI Impact Assessment for '{{MODEL_TYPE}}' processing '{{DATA_INPUT_TYPE}}'.
Analyze prompt injection vulnerabilities, hallucination probabilities, data leakage risks, and fallback mechanisms.
Propose PEAS framework specifications and incident reporting thresholds.
educational_overlay.fictional_scenario: An insurance company builds an LLM agent that reads claim receipts and estimates reimbursement eligibility for medical procedures.
educational_overlay.sample_output:
### AI Impact Assessment (Executive Summary)
- **Hallucination Risk**: Model may misinterpret medical billing codes resulting in erroneous claim rejections.
- **Mitigation**: Require deterministic claim adjudication engine for financial calculations; LLM restricted to text extraction.
guardrails: Financial and medical determinations must never rely solely on probabilistic model text.
verification_checklist: Conduct red-teaming for prompt injection attacks.
Implement automated PII scrubbing prior to LLM inference.
educational_overlay.ai_risk_warning: RAG retrieval accuracy degrades with poorly formatted scanned PDF documents.
